title: Proposal for Licensing Requirement for Pet Boarding Business
what_it_is: Proposal for Licensing Requirement for Pet Boarding Business

sections.label: Pet boarding regulation review
sections.summary: AVA can enforce against pet boarders under the Animals and Birds Act and intends a holistic review of pet industry regulation, engaging stakeholders.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Beyond the Code of Animal Welfare, the Agri-Food and Veterinary Authority (AVA) can take enforcement action against pet boarding businesses under the Animals and Birds Act for failing in this duty of care, or for animal cruelty.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: AVA currently licenses pet shops and pet farms, some of which have commercial pet boarding facilities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: AVA intends to undertake a holistic review of the regulatory approach for the pet industry, including how best to regulate pet boarding businesses.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: As part of this review, AVA will engage its stakeholders, including pet owners, industry players and Animal Welfare Groups, to find the right balance across their various needs and interests.

sections.label: List of commercial boarders
sections.summary: AVA has a list of commercial boarders in the pet farms.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: AVA has a list of commercial boarders in the pet farms.

sections.label: Pet boarder licensing and consultation
sections.summary: Pet boarders need no licence unless on farm land, and many well-meaning pet lovers provide boarding, so consultation will be comprehensive.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Pet boarders currently are not required to be licensed unless they are on farm land.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: We also need to be mindful that there are many pet boarders out there who are do-gooders, well-meaning pet lovers, who provide pet boarding facilities.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: And there are various different stakeholders that we have to consult.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, rest assured it is not that I do not want to give a timeline, but because we want to be comprehensive and holistic about it.
